what: Work photo sections are pinned to the screen and stacked, and while scrolling, the next section pushes in from the right edge as a clipped face (clip-path) and covers the previous one (one screen height per section · power2.inOut). The incoming section’s photo settles from 1.1× to its own size, and the caption row (category·text·button) floats up in .4s from 60% down at .08s intervals once the section is half covered. It follows with scrub .6, and when released it snaps to the nearest section in .2~.6s
ease: power2.inOut (cover) · power2.out (photo settling · caption) · snap power1.inOut

options.scrub: Follow delay (seconds), default .6 — if on, follows immediately with no delay (true)
options.zoom: Starting scale of the incoming photo, default 1.1 — 1 means it does not sink in (phone original)
options.each: Scroll used per section (screen-height multiple), default 1
options.snap: If off, does not pause at each section
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo that sinks within the section (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: Caption lines that float up inside the section (optional, multiple)
options.ease: Curve for each section clearing away, default power2.inOut — original value ("0.65,0,0.35,1") too
options.beam: When on, a 3px light beam (120px glow toward the right) travels with the clearing edge, and raises the outgoing section’s --fx-shade from 0 to shade
options.shade: End value of --fx-shade for sections leaving in the beam type, default .5 — the css that uses it darkens by this amount
options.min: Minimum scroll per section (px), default 0 — the larger of this and each
options.fx:slide: Event the panel emits when the section changes (detail.index · count) — updates the dot list and the next-section preview
options.top: Position to pin at (px) — if there is a fixed header above, its height. The panel height is also reduced by this much from the screen, default 0

note: While pinned, the timeline runs and a spacer (pin-spacer) is added. With reduced motion, the sections remain as a stacked list

from.where: index.js project section (.rk-projects — four photos pinned and flipped)

detail.html .e-gallery (original project-gallery horizontal type — each section scrolls max(320, screen×.8) · follows progress directly (no ease) · inset left 100→0 · light pillar 3px + 120px glow · outgoing section shade ×.5)
